Our Capabilities
Nutritional Bars
Our nutritional bar lines provide flexibility across the manufacturing process. By focusing on customization, we ensure every bar is tailored to meet the unique dietary preferences and wellness goals of consumers, offering “better-for-you” options packed with quality ingredients that fuel success for your brand.
View All Capabilities
Baked Bars
Our four state-of-the-art baking lines are designed to produce a wide variety of products, including baked breakfast bars, co-extruded items, wire-cut protein cookies, and rotary-formed biscuits. We offer the flexibility to incorporate diverse forming techniques at the start of the baking process and provide custom decoration solutions after cooling. Our baked snacks deliver a wide range of textures and flavors that consistently appeal to consumers. From classic cookies with inclusions to high-protein, low-sugar, better-for-you options, our formulas are tailored to meet the unique needs of your brand.
Wafer Cookies
Wafer bars with cream layers offer a versatile and innovative platform for a variety of product capabilities. They combine the light, crisp texture of wafers with rich, creamy fillings to create an indulgent yet balanced treat. We have two top of the line wafer ovens that result in high quality, consistent wafer bars. With the ability to incorporate diverse flavors, from classic vanilla to exotic fruits, wafer bars with cream fillings can cater to a broad range of consumer preferences. Additionally, they provide opportunities for customization in coatings, inclusions, size, shape, and packaging, making them an excellent option for on-the-go snacking.
Chocolate Moulding
Our moulding lines offer a wide range of flexibility from the ability to receive and store bulk chocolate to the many different final pack configurations available. Each line has dedicated tempering units along with a wide range of options for handling center material. Moulds are fully customizable to create a wide rage of shapes, embossed pieces, and bars.
Granola
Our equipment is designed to produce a wide variety of baked granola products with the ability to add inclusions post bake. From plain granola to nut, chocolate, and fruit inclusions, we can handle your demand. Our baking, distribution, and bagging line ensures fresh and accurate product delivery.
Brand Protection
Unmatched quality and unparalleled safety standards are our hallmarks for success. We prioritize brand protection, food quality, and safety above all else.

TruFood Manufacturing is a leading contract manufacturer of branded and private-label nutrition bars, protein bars, chocolate moulded products, and baked goods. These products are sold at club, grocery, drug, and convenience stores worldwide. TruFood has a large presence on the East Coast with over 400,000 sq. ft. of state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities and continues to grow through its strong reputation for manufacturing high quality snack products for its marquee customer base.
About Bar Bakers
Bar Bakers is a leading contract manufacturer of branded nutrition and protein bars, baked bars and cookies and wafer bars. These products are primarily sold throughout the US and Canada at club, grocery, drug, and convenience stores. Bar Bakers has more than 1,000 employees across four manufacturing sites and two warehouses in California and is headquartered in Los Alamitos, CA. and continues to grow through its strong reputation for manufacturing high quality snack products for its marquee customer base.
About Mubadala Capital
Tandem Foods is a premier contract manufacturer of better-for-you snacks, focused on delivering high-quality products, operational excellence, and unmatched value to its marquee customer base. Formed from the union of TruFood Manufacturing and Bar Bakers, Tandem Foods combines decades of expertise and strong value heritage with expanded capabilities across eight manufacturing facilities nationwide. We specialize in the manufacturing of a wide range of products, including baked, extruded, and cold-slab bars, chocolate moulding, cookies, wafers, granola, fruit bars and more. Guided by its tagline, “Powered by Collaboration,” Tandem Foods prioritizes partnerships with customers, employees, and communities to drive success in the rapidly evolving better-for-you snack market. For more information, visit www.tandemfoods.com.

Mubadala Capital Portfolio Company TruFood Manufacturing to Combine with Bar Bakers - Tandem Foods
New York, Pittsburgh, Los Alamitos / Abu Dhabi, UAE – April 30, 2024, TruFood Manufacturing, a leading U.S. contract manufacturer specializing in better-for-you nutrition bars, chocolate and baked granola, today announced the successful completion of its combination with Bar Bakers, LLC (“Bar Bakers”), a prominent player in nutritional snacks manufacturing. The union of these two leading companies is expected to create a scaled industry player with a significant footprint across product categories and geographies. Although the financial specifics remain private, investment firm Manna Tree has joined Mubadala Capital in supporting this venture.
TruFood’s Chief Executive Officer, Michael Buick, will oversee the combined company. Harold Rothman, Founder and CEO of Bar Bakers, will join the new company’s Board of Directors, while Gary Jacobs, President of Bar Bakers, will become its Chief Operating Officer.
Commenting on the transaction, Buick said: “The coming together of TruFood and Bar Bakers marks a significant milestone as it strengthens our position in the nutritional snacks market. As a result, we have expanded our capabilities and portfolio of products and strategically extended our manufacturing footprint to the west coast. The combined company’s expertise and resources will enable us to better serve our customers and to accelerate our growth opportunities. I am thrilled to welcome Bar Bakers to our family. Their track record of customer partnership and operational excellence align perfectly with our values and vision.”
Since its inception in 2013, Bar Bakers has been an integral west coast manufacturer for major nutritional snack brands, offering cutting-edge production capabilities. Their market leading technologies in cold form, baked bars, and cookie and wafer manufacturing complements TruFood’s existing strengths, which is expected to cultivate deeper relationships with customers and speed up innovation. Bar Bakers, which is headquartered in Los Alamitos, California, has more than 1,000 employees across four manufacturing sites and two warehouses in California. The integration process will be conducted with careful consideration to ensure a smooth transition for employees, customers, and other stakeholders.
“Together with Mubadala Capital, Manna Tree and TruFood, Bar Bakers will have greater resources and new capabilities to support the continued growth of our valued customers,” added Rothman. “On behalf of everyone at Bar Bakers, we look forward to coming together with the TruFood team and are confident that, together, the combined company will be best positioned to address the evolving needs of our customers and drive continued success for them, for our employees, partners and all our stakeholders. I look forward to supporting the company and advising the management team from my board position.”
Adnan Azam, Executive Director at Mubadala Capital, added: “We see significant value in bringing together TruFood and Bar Bakers to create a single company that has the capabilities and expertise to lead this industry in the years ahead. This transaction reinforces our strong commitment to TruFood and Bar Bakers’ growth strategy as we add network capacity, broaden our production capacity, and expand our position in high growth categories. We are excited to welcome the Bar Bakers team and employees to the Mubadala Capital family as we continue to build a market leader in nutrition snacks.”
Steve Young, Managing Partner at Manna Tree, added: “The better-for-you bar market is large and growing and TruFood and Bar Bakers’ innovative product portfolio and unwavering commitment to nutrition and quality make them the leader in manufacturing for the bar category’s largest health-forward brands. As consumer preferences continue evolving towards healthier, more protein rich options, we believe the combination of TruFood and Bar Bakers is exceptionally well-positioned to capitalize on these favorable market trends.”
Akin Gump Strauss Hauer & Feld LLP acted as legal advisors to Mubadala Capital. Winston & Strawn LLP acted as legal advisors and Houlihan Lokey as financial advisors to Bar Bakers.
